plain_english: Ah, honeyed past honey, the savour of serving Śarva hoped — in what tick of time does it not turn ever-new?
sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate

plain_english: Ever, unwearied, teeming the triple world with hundredfold fancies — yet single, seamless, lords it — Unborn.
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ

plain_english: By lore's lamp that licks the birth-greased wick of wonts — god, O when shall I stand in your presence, prithee?
sanskrit_cite: malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ

plain_english: Grant one blinking's room with faults outworn to lodge within the breast — then, Śambhu, what feat past your doing?
sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

plain_english: 'Blest am I, quits am I, big am I' — firm would that fancy stand, grounded — his whom you ground, lord.
sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho

plain_english: Luck and muck alike you author yourself — yet love of you mothers luck only, solely, lord.
sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

plain_english: Mind pellucid, master — step you in, or at your stepping does it clear? So dangles man.
sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

plain_english: Nay, here stands sure — your oversight and yours only: mind's favour, master, is fulfilment, the farthest seat.
sanskrit_cite: niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam

plain_english: Word and wit, work and this frame of mine, lord — grace them to gleam with love of you and nought beside.
sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

plain_english: This praise-gem, heavy with granted longings, Lakṣmī's lodging of love — for Śambhu wrought Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.
sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt
